description: "The Student's Elements of Geology" by Sir Charles Lyell is a scientific publication written in the late 19th century. This comprehensive work aims to introduce fundamental principles of geology, making it accessible to beginners while providing essential insights into the structure and formation of the Earth's crust, as well as the classification of various types of rocks and fossils.
